content: Apple Health charts: touch-and-hold to read a point value with a lollipop/tooltip; drag to scrub; segmented time-range picker (D/W/M/6M/Y); Highlights cards overlay two related metrics; third-party apps (Health Hive, HealthFit) exist specifically to compare metrics Apple does not overlay natively. Specific gesture documentation not in indexed support page; behavior confirmed from general ecosystem knowledge + app store descriptions.
